title: Gain Bounds for Diagonal Superelliptic Equations under the Strong ABC Conjecture
summary: We establish a novel framework for bounding the adapted power gain $G_p$ and approximation gain $G_a$ of coprime integer solutions to the generalized diagonal superelliptic equation $By^n = Ax^n + k$ with $x, y \ge 2$. By first deriving a purely structural lower bound for $G_a$, we demonstrate that these equations are inherently predisposed to high ABC-qualities ($q = G_a \cdot G_p$).
